استضأت (form X)
# اِسْتَضَأْتُ (istaḍaʔtu) /is.ta.dˤaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَضَاءَ (istaḍāʔa)
# اِسْتَضَأْتَ (istaḍaʔta) /is.ta.dˤaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَضَاءَ (istaḍāʔa)
# اِسْتَضَأْتِ (istaḍaʔti) /is.ta.dˤaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَضَاءَ (istaḍāʔa)
